newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine flour mills buy 41,000 T U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Philippine flour mills buy 41,000 T U.S. wheat.

text.p: Philippine flour mills bought 41,000 tonnes U.S. wheat for immediate delivery over the weekend, traders said on Tuesday.

U.S. trading firm Cargill sold 8,000 (tonnes) each of dark northern spring wheat with a 13.5 percent protein content and western white wheat. The rest was sold by a Japanese commodity house, said one Manila trader.
Traders said they expected Philippine flour mills to go back in the market in the next few days to cover their October and November requirements.
"But some well-stocked mills can afford to wait for better prices at this point," said one local dealer.
